long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Rome, Lombardi Stronati earned degrees in economics and law at Sapienza University. He began in tax and mergers-and-acquisitions consulting at Arthur & Young, collaborated with Sapienza's tax-law chair and taught public finance at LUISS. After moving to London in 1994, he founded Credit Securitization in New York, building a business around securitised receivables, particularly claims on public administrations.

His finance identity continued through Credsec and his presidency of the European Observatory on Investment Capital, where he has addressed non-performing-loan markets. For three years, he was majority owner and president of Siena, adding a Serie A governance chapter to his career. He has also developed a sustained competitive-sailing programme, founding Team Django and earning national recognition after a world championship and major race victories.
